notes: Live BPM counters now track a synced follower when you change the leader's tempo - no more frozen counter after SYNC.
Half/double-time beatmatches (e.g. 140 vs 70) read as matched, with a small half/double tag next to the BPM readout.
SYNC shows a clear "can't sync" state when two tracks are more than +/-15 percent apart, instead of doing nothing silently.
Library Play now auditions the selected track immediately on Deck A and counts it as a play.
